theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Dark Mode)
theme_and_archetype.description: A high-end, brutalist-inspired dark tech aesthetic. Uses obsidian blacks, stark white typography, and vibrant but deeply saturated neon accents (Emerald & Cyan) to denote AI and communication. No soft dropshadows—only crisp 1px borders, architectural spacing, and targeted light bleeds.

bot.description: Blue theme for AI bot messages

admin.description: Gray theme for manual admin messages

spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-[260px] fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen border-r border-white/5 bg-[#050505]

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background (bg-[#111] or bg-[#0A0A0A]), crisp 1px border (border-white/5), rounded-md. Hover state: border-white/20 with subtle -translate-y-[1px] transition.
surface_strategies.glass_header: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5 sticky top-0 z-50
surface_strategies.ai_toggle: Use 'The Tracing Beam' or Neumorphic inset dark approach. Example: bg-[#111] border-white/10 rounded-full p-1. Active state glows with cyan/emerald.
surface_strategies.buttons: Sharp corners or rounded-sm. Primary: bg-emerald-500 text-black hover:bg-emerald-400 font-semibold. Use pure white text on dark gray for secondary actions.

components_instructions.login_page: Use the provided 3D abstract background image in a split-screen or full-screen under a glassmorphism card. Keep the form brutalist: transparent inputs with bottom borders or solid 1px borders. Add 'Welcome back, Operator' or similar technical copy.
components_instructions.sidebar_nav: Dark #050505 bg. Links should have hover states (bg-white/5 text-white). Active state: subtle left border highlight (border-l-2 border-emerald-500) or pure text highlight.
components_instructions.inbox_panel_left: Contact list. Each item should have a hover effect. Show unread indicators in electric emerald or cyan.
components_instructions.inbox_panel_right: Message history. Sticky top header with contact name and AI Toggle. Scrollable message area. Sticky bottom input with absolute positioned send icon.
components_instructions.message_bubbles: Follow color rules. Max-width 75%. Customer left, Bot/Admin right. Use flex flex-col gap-4. Add 1px solid borders to bubbles to ground them.
components_instructions.templates_cards: Use 'Grid Borders' look. Show template name, language, preview text, and status badge. Keep background flat and tech-focused.
components_instructions.campaign_form: Shadcn-based form with select for template, textarea for phone numbers. Crisp inputs, high contrast focus states (focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500).

login_bg.description: Abstract 3D glassmorphism dark mode background with emerald and cyan edges. Use as the background or side panel for the login page.

media_assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Import Bot, Sparkles, MessageSquare, LayoutGrid, Megaphone, LogOut, Send.

testing_requirements: All interactive elements must have data-testid. E.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='ai-toggle-switch', data-testid='contact-item', data-testid='campaign-submit'.
